amendments.reason: Merged PR #120 explicitly assigns the dispatcher release barrier to RECON-010, while the generated plan entry retained a narrower write scope. This exact-path amendment reconciles that contradiction without rewriting the sealed plan fingerprint or BOOT-000 attestation.
additional_acceptance_criteria: Unreleased workers remain WAIT while dispatcher reconciliation/release is incomplete.
A worker is claimable only after a current explicit START NOW release for that exact node.
A parallel wave is executable only after an explicit START TOGETHER NOW release naming that wave.
Every dispatcher candidate receives exactly one verdict: START NOW, WAIT, or STOP.
Dispatcher output plainly states how many worker sessions to open.
Static DAG or level membership alone never authorizes execution.
Target advance, merge, conflicting claim, snapshot change, or reconciliation event invalidates prior release instructions.
constraints: No authority expansion for any node other than RECON-010.
No write authority beyond the exact enumerated additional paths.
